Alfie Jones.note: Jones is back-line insurance for Canada. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Alfie Jones.noteZh: 他给Canada那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Ali Ahmed.note: Ahmed is a tempo player for Canada. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Ali Ahmed.noteZh: 他让Canada在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Alistair Johnston.note: Johnston gives Canada one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Alistair Johnston.noteZh: 他是Canada无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Alphonso Davies.note: Davies is the kind of defender Canada can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Alphonso Davies.noteZh: 他是Canada艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Cyle Larin.note: Larin has been one of Canada's real scoring stories, with goals against Bosnia and Herzegovina and Qatar. His danger is arriving before defenders have finished sorting the first problem.
Cyle Larin.noteZh: 他已经多次为Canada把机会变成进球。看他需要的空间有多小。

Dayne St. Clair.note: Clair gives Canada a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Dayne St. Clair.noteZh: 他在Canada首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Derek Cornelius.note: Cornelius is in the quiet-work part of Canada's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Derek Cornelius.noteZh: 他是Canada主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Ismael Kone.note: Koné gives Canada a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Ismael Kone.noteZh: 他是Canada的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Jacob Shaffelburg.note: Shaffelburg is the forward Canada can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Jacob Shaffelburg.noteZh: 他给Canada替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Joel Waterman.note: Waterman gives Canada cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Joel Waterman.noteZh: 他是Canada后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Jonathan David.note: David has been one of Canada's real scoring stories, with goals against Qatar. His danger is arriving before defenders have finished sorting the first problem.
Jonathan David.noteZh: 他已经多次为Canada把机会变成进球。看他需要的空间有多小。

Jonathan Osorio.note: Osorio gives Canada midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Jonathan Osorio.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Canada来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Liam Millar.note: Millar gives Canada midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Liam Millar.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Canada来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Luc De Fougerolles.note: Fougerolles gives Canada one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Luc De Fougerolles.noteZh: 他是Canada无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Marcelo Flores.note: Flores gives Canada midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Marcelo Flores.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Canada来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Mathieu Choiniere.note: Choinière is midfield insurance for Canada. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Mathieu Choiniere.noteZh: 他给Canada一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Maxime Crepeau.note: Crépeau is the last voice in Canada's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Maxime Crepeau.noteZh: 他承担了Canada的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Moise Bombito.note: Bombito is defensive rotation for Canada. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Moise Bombito.noteZh: 他是Canada后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Nathan Saliba.note: Saliba has already given Canada a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Nathan Saliba.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Canada贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Niko Sigur.note: Sigur is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Canada, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Niko Sigur.noteZh: 他给Canada提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Owen Goodman.note: Goodman is goalkeeper cover for Canada. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Owen Goodman.noteZh: 他是Canada门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Promise David.note: David has already given Canada a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Promise David.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Canada贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Richie Laryea.note: Laryea gives Canada one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Richie Laryea.noteZh: 他是Canada无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Stephen Eustaquio.club: Los Angeles FC (on loan from Porto)
Stephen Eustaquio.note: Eustáquio's World Cup has already included a goal against South Africa. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Stephen Eustaquio.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Tajon Buchanan.note: Buchanan has been part of Canada's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Tajon Buchanan.noteZh: 他在Canada体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Tani Oluwaseyi.note: Oluwaseyi has been part of Canada's front-line plan. He stretches defenders first, then looks for the touch that turns pressure into a chance.
Tani Oluwaseyi.noteZh: 他是Canada前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。
